title: Forlorn Ridge
wikitext:
[[Image:Forlorn Ridge.jpg|thumb|Forlorn Ridge]]
The '''Forlorn Ridge''' is a huge long-dead volcano located in southwestern [[Azshara]]. It completely dominates the nearby landscape, and both the [[Alliance]] and the [[Horde]] have built fortifications on the side of the mountain. Many believe it to be the site of the "lost" battleground, [[Azshara Crater]].

You can discover this at {{co|25.7|76.5|Azshara}}.
